title: mercurialis ovata f. genuina
intro: Mercurialis ovata f. genuina, commonly known as Spurge, is a perennial plant species within the genus Mercurialis. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its reported health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mercurialis ovata f. genuina include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
